title: The Maharashtra Jeevan Authority Act, 1976.
full_text: The Maharashtra Jeevan Authority Act, 1976. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 197648 Act Number: 48 Enactment Date: 1976-11-11 Act Year: 1976 Short Title: The Maharashtra Jeevan Authority Act, 1976. Long Title: An Act to provide for establishment of a (Jeevan Authority) for rapid development and proper regulation of water supply and sewerage services in the State of Maharashtra.
